content.scenario: TechCorp, a multinational technology company, has its head office in New York but operates a smaller office in Mumbai, India, which it refers to as its 'Asia-Pacific Branch'. This branch is responsible for sales and customer support for TechCorp's products in the region, mirroring the activities of the head office.
content.outcome: The office in Mumbai would be considered a branch office under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, as it is described as a branch by the establishment (TechCorp) and carries on substantially the same activities as the head office.
